-- Dados de faturamento de maio/2026 por unidade
SELECT 
  f.empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as diasLancados,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL) + 
      CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL) + 
      CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL)) as totalRealizado,
  AVG(CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL) + 
      CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL) + 
      CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL) + CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL)) as mediaDiaria,
  m.metaMensal,
  m.diasUteis
FROM faturamentos f
JOIN metas m ON m.empresaSlug = f.empresaSlug AND m.mes = 5 AND m.ano = 2026
WHERE f.empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-morumbi', 'barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-seraphine')
  AND f.data BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-17'
GROUP BY f.empresaSlug, m.metaMensal, m.diasUteis
ORDER BY f.empresaSlug;
